text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (March 20, 2025) for 75 Alberta Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee – Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (March 20, 2025) for 75 Alberta Avenue, Folder Number 25 132383 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 12, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
